filter.reason: Heroicons' 'funnel' is the standard filter icon, a funnel/cone shape for filtering results

sort.reason: Heroicons' 'bars-arrow-down' shows horizontal bars with a downward arrow, representing sort order

list.reason: Heroicons' 'list-bullet' shows a bulleted list layout, direct match for list view

table.reason: Heroicons' 'table-cells' shows a grid of table cells, direct match for table/spreadsheet view

grid.reason: Heroicons' 'squares-2x2' shows a 2x2 grid of squares, standard grid/card view icon

chart-bar.reason: Heroicons' 'chart-bar' is a direct name match for bar chart visualization

chart-line.reason: Heroicons has no line chart icon. Only chart-bar and chart-pie are available; no line/trend chart exists

chart-pie.reason: Heroicons' 'chart-pie' is a direct name match for pie chart visualization

view.reason: Heroicons' 'eye' is the standard visibility/show icon, direct semantic match

hide.reason: Heroicons' 'eye-slash' is the standard hide/invisible icon, an eye with a diagonal slash

search.reason: Heroicons renamed 'search' to 'magnifying-glass' in v2, the standard search icon

zoom-in.reason: Heroicons' 'magnifying-glass-plus' shows a magnifying glass with a plus sign for zoom in

zoom-out.reason: Heroicons' 'magnifying-glass-minus' shows a magnifying glass with a minus sign for zoom out

fullscreen.reason: Heroicons' 'arrows-pointing-out' shows four arrows pointing outward, the standard maximize/fullscreen icon

exit-fullscreen.reason: Heroicons' 'arrows-pointing-in' shows four arrows pointing inward, the standard minimize/exit fullscreen icon

board.reason: Heroicons' 'view-columns' shows a columnar layout, the closest match to a kanban/board view

activity.reason: Heroicons has no activity/pulse icon. There is no heartbeat, waveform, or activity monitor equivalent in the set

success.reason: Heroicons' 'check-circle' is a checkmark inside a circle, the universal success/complete indicator

error.reason: Heroicons' 'x-circle' is an X inside a circle, the standard error/failed indicator

warning.reason: Heroicons' 'exclamation-triangle' is an exclamation mark in a triangle, the universal warning/caution symbol

info.reason: Heroicons' 'information-circle' is an 'i' inside a circle, the standard information indicator

help.reason: Heroicons' 'question-mark-circle' is a question mark inside a circle, the standard help/FAQ icon

loading.reason: Heroicons' 'arrow-path' shows circular arrows suggesting refresh/loading. Heroicons has no dedicated spinner icon, and this is the closest match

filled-circle.reason: Heroicons has no filled circle/dot icon. There is no solid disc, radio-selected, or dot indicator in the set

empty-circle.reason: Heroicons has no empty circle outline icon suitable for an inactive/unselected radio state

verified.reason: Heroicons' 'check-badge' is a badge with a checkmark, the standard verified/trusted indicator

smile.reason: Heroicons' 'face-smile' is a smiling face emoji, direct semantic match for happy/satisfied mood

frown.reason: Heroicons' 'face-frown' is a frowning face emoji, direct semantic match for sad/dissatisfied mood

fire.reason: Heroicons' 'fire' is a direct name match, a flame icon for hot/trending content

tip.reason: Heroicons' 'light-bulb' is the standard tip/idea/hint icon, a lightbulb shape

support.reason: Heroicons' 'lifebuoy' is a life preserver ring, the standard support/help icon

like.reason: Heroicons' 'heart' is the standard like/favorite icon, a heart shape

unlike.reason: Heroicons has no broken heart or heart-crack icon. No suitable unlike/unfavorite equivalent exists

star.reason: Heroicons' 'star' is a direct name match, the standard star/favorite/rating icon

bookmark.reason: Heroicons' 'bookmark' is a direct name match, the standard save-for-later icon

thumbs-up.reason: Heroicons' 'hand-thumb-up' is a thumbs-up gesture, the standard upvote/approval icon

thumbs-down.reason: Heroicons' 'hand-thumb-down' is a thumbs-down gesture, the standard downvote/disapproval icon

reply.reason: Heroicons' 'arrow-uturn-left' is a curved arrow pointing back, the standard reply icon pattern

comment.reason: Heroicons' 'chat-bubble-left' is a single speech bubble, direct match for comment/message

comments.reason: Heroicons' 'chat-bubble-left-right' shows two overlapping speech bubbles, representing multiple comments/discussion

typing.reason: Heroicons' 'chat-bubble-left-ellipsis' is a speech bubble with three dots, the standard typing/composing indicator

mention.reason: Heroicons' 'at-symbol' is the @ sign, the universal mention/at symbol

block.reason: Heroicons' 'no-symbol' is a circle with a diagonal line through it, the standard block/ban/prohibited icon

flag.reason: Heroicons' 'flag' is a direct name match, the standard flag/report icon

pin.reason: Heroicons has no thumbtack/pin icon. There is a map-pin but it represents geographic location, not a pinned/bookmarked item

award.reason: Heroicons has no award ribbon or badge/achievement icon. 'check-badge' is for verification, not awards. No suitable match

trophy.reason: Heroicons' 'trophy' is a direct name match, the standard achievement/winner icon

gift.reason: Heroicons' 'gift' is a direct name match, the standard gift/reward/present icon

target.reason: Heroicons has no target/bullseye/crosshair icon suitable for goal/target. The 'viewfinder-circle' is a camera viewfinder, not a target

bold.reason: Heroicons' 'bold' is a direct name match for bold text formatting (letter B)

italic.reason: Heroicons' 'italic' is a direct name match for italic text formatting (letter I)

underline.reason: Heroicons' 'underline' is a direct name match for underline text formatting (letter U with underline)

strikethrough.reason: Heroicons' 'strikethrough' is a direct name match for strikethrough text formatting

code.reason: Heroicons' 'code-bracket' shows angle brackets <>, the standard code/markup icon

quote.reason: Heroicons has no blockquote or quotation mark icon. No suitable match for blockquote formatting

heading.reason: Heroicons' 'h1' was added in v2.1.5 as a text formatting icon, representing a primary heading

paragraph.reason: Heroicons has no paragraph pilcrow icon. No paragraph formatting equivalent exists

bullet-list.reason: Heroicons' 'list-bullet' is a bulleted list icon, direct semantic match for unordered lists

numbered-list.reason: Heroicons' 'numbered-list' was added in v2.1.5 as a text formatting icon, direct name match for ordered lists

checklist.reason: Heroicons has no checklist or todo-list icon. The 'clipboard-document-check' is for document verification, not a checklist editor tool

indent.reason: Heroicons has no indent icon. No text indentation formatting equivalent exists in the set

outdent.reason: Heroicons has no outdent/dedent icon. No text outdentation formatting equivalent exists in the set

align-left.reason: Heroicons has no text alignment icons. Bars-3/bars-3-bottom-left are navigation menus, not text alignment

align-center.reason: Heroicons has no text alignment icons. No center-align formatting equivalent exists

align-right.reason: Heroicons has no text alignment icons. No right-align formatting equivalent exists

justify.reason: Heroicons has no text alignment icons. No justify formatting equivalent exists

emoji.reason: Heroicons' 'face-smile' is a smiley face, the standard emoji picker trigger icon
